public_rationale: The reviewed research points toward practical gains, but does not securely settle the improvement-over-time claim for the chosen period. METR's survey measures perceptions, while its experimental follow-up has serious selection problems. Neither establishes the exclusive explanation of revenue. These gaps prevent support, but uncertainty about the measurements is not evidence that improvement is absent.
limitations: The claim combines a performance trend with a sweeping explanation of commercial demand.
Results depend on the unstated baseline and definition of better.
The search does not establish that no qualifying study exists.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is not measurably improving except on AI-specific benchmarks and only makes money through subsidies, FOMO and executive ignorance.

statement.excerpt: It isn’t becoming “better” in a way that’s measurable using anything other than benchmarks invented specifically for generative AI — an industry-wide coddling of a mediocre technology that only makes money through massive subsidies, FOMO and executive ignorance.

from_speaker: measurable using anything other than benchmarks invented specifically for generative AI
only makes money through massive subsidies, FOMO and executive ignorance
our_interpretation: Becoming better means improvement over time in practical outcomes, such as completion time or output quality, beyond scores on AI-specific benchmarks.
Evidence that AI users outperform nonusers at one point in time does not by itself establish improvement across model generations.
Only makes money is read as a claim that commercial demand lacks an independently demonstrated economic basis outside the named mechanisms, not as a precise net-income assertion.
For the ongoing state without a named period, I use the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, January–March 2026. Earlier measurements serve as comparison context.
The exclusive explanation of revenue has a causal component, but the main assessable proposition is the asserted absence of measurable practical improvement.
criteria.support_condition: Credible comparisons over time find no practical improvement outside excluded benchmarks, and evidence establishes that the listed mechanisms exhaust the economic explanation for commercial receipts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable comparisons show practical improvement over time outside AI-specific benchmarks, or documented commercial economics establish an independent basis for revenue beyond the named mechanisms.
